units: Ḥull. 7ᵇ; Snh. 67ᵇ למה … כ̇שׁפ̇ים (Ms. M. מכשפים) why are they called kashshafim? מפני שמכֹחישׁין פ̇מליא של מעלה because they lessen the power of divine agencies.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 80">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXX</cite>, end <he>כשפין</he> (ed. Bub. <cite ref="K01323"><he>כַּשְׁפָּנִין</he></cite>; oth. ed. <he>מְכַשְּׁפִין</he>); a. e.—V. <cite ref="M01443"><he>מְכַשֵּׁף</he></cite>.
